Canonical records

Knowledge that can travel.

A record is one Markdown file with a validated contract: identifier, kind, status, revision, and summary. It is authored once and published to people and machines from that single source.

Register

Every record, with its state on the page.

Status and revision are part of the record, not editorial framing added afterwards.
